title: 知识正文与原理图
prompt: “解释光合作用是什么，再配个简单原理图。”
program:
root = Col([Title("光合作用：把阳光变成糖", "xl"), intro, equation, diagramCard, keyPoints, facts])
$stage = "总览"
intro = Markdown("光合作用是植物、藻类和部分细菌把**光能**变成化学能、把无机物变成有机物的过程。叶绿体吸收光，把 **CO₂ + H₂O** 合成葡萄糖，并放出氧气。")
equation = Math("6CO_2 + 6H_2O \\xrightarrow{光能} C_6H_{12}O_6 + 6O_2")
diagramCard = Card([hint, SegmentedControl($stage, ["总览", "光反应", "暗反应"], true), Box([diagram], null, null, 3, "surface", "lg"), phaseTitle, phaseText], null, 4)
hint = Caption("点击下方按钮切换阶段，查看光反应与暗反应")
phaseTitle = Title($stage == "总览" ? "总览：光 + 水 + 二氧化碳 → 糖 + 氧气" : $stage == "光反应" ? "光反应：把光能变成化学能" : "暗反应：把二氧化碳固定成糖", "md")
phaseText = Text($stage == "总览" ? "光能先被叶绿素捕获，水分解产生氧气，并把能量存进 ATP 和 NADPH；暗反应再用这些能量把二氧化碳合成葡萄糖。" : $stage == "光反应" ? "光反应发生在类囊体膜上。光能驱动水分解，释放氧气，并生成 ATP 和 NADPH。" : "暗反应（Calvin 循环）发生在叶绿体基质。它不直接需要光，但依赖 ATP 和 NADPH，把二氧化碳固定为葡萄糖。", "sm", "muted")
keyPoints = Markdown("### 两个阶段\n- **光反应**：在类囊体膜上，把光能变成 ATP 和 NADPH，同时水分解产生 O₂。\n- **暗反应（Calvin 循环）**：在叶绿体基质中，用 ATP 和 NADPH 把 CO₂ 固定成葡萄糖。")
facts = Row([Badge("发生在叶绿体", "success", "leaf"), Badge("需要光和叶绿素", "info", "sun"), Badge("释放氧气", "warning", "wind")], 2, null, null, true)
diagram = $stage == "总览" ? overviewSvg : $stage == "光反应" ? lightSvg : darkSvg
overviewSvg = Svg([Circle(58, 58, 26, "#F4B740"), SvgText("光", 58, 63, 14, "#7A4B00", "middle", "semibold"), Line(58, 20, 58, 10, "#F4B740", 3), Line(58, 96, 58, 106, "#F4B740", 3), Line(20, 58, 10, 58, "#F4B740", 3), Line(96, 58, 106, 58, "#F4B740", 3), Line(31, 31, 24, 24, "#F4B740", 3), Line(85, 31, 92, 24, "#F4B740", 3), Line(31, 85, 24, 92, "#F4B740", 3), Line(85, 85, 92, 92, "#F4B740", 3), Ellipse(210, 160, 100, 42, "#6FCF97", "#2F6B4F", 2), Line(112, 160, 308, 160, "#2F6B4F", 1.5), Path("M 140 160 Q 170 130 200 160", "none", "#2F6B4F", 1.5), Path("M 220 160 Q 250 130 280 160", "none", "#2F6B4F", 1.5), SvgText("叶绿体", 210, 165, 14, "#1F5C3A", "middle", "semibold"), Line(360, 60, 310, 116, "#5B8DEF", 3), Polygon("304,112 320,112 314,126", "#5B8DEF"), SvgText("CO₂", 372, 58, 13, "#2F6B4F", "start", "semibold"), Line(80, 270, 148, 200, "#5B8DEF", 3), Polygon("142,194 158,196 152,208", "#5B8DEF"), SvgText("H₂O", 38, 282, 13, "#2F6B4F", "start", "semibold"), Line(210, 112, 210, 58, "#EB5757", 3), Polygon("205,52 210,42 215,52", "#EB5757"), SvgText("O₂", 224, 62, 13, "#B03A3A", "start", "semibold"), Line(280, 190, 340, 248, "#F2994A", 3), Polygon("334,242 350,244 342,254", "#F2994A"), SvgText("C₆H₁₂O₆", 316, 278, 13, "#8A5A1A", "start", "semibold")], "0 0 420 300")
lightSvg = Svg([Circle(58, 58, 26, "#F4B740"), SvgText("光", 58, 63, 14, "#7A4B00", "middle", "semibold"), Line(58, 20, 58, 10, "#F4B740", 3), Line(58, 96, 58, 106, "#F4B740", 3), Line(20, 58, 10, 58, "#F4B740", 3), Line(96, 58, 106, 58, "#F4B740", 3), Line(31, 31, 24, 24, "#F4B740", 3), Line(85, 31, 92, 24, "#F4B740", 3), Line(31, 85, 24, 92, "#F4B740", 3), Line(85, 85, 92, 92, "#F4B740", 3), Line(95, 70, 176, 124, "#F4B740", 3), Polygon("170,118 186,120 180,132", "#F4B740"), Ellipse(210, 170, 145, 62, "#DDF3E4", "#4F8A5B", 2), Rect(150, 132, 120, 14, "#6FCF97", "#2F6B4F", 2, null, 7), Rect(158, 148, 112, 14, "#6FCF97", "#2F6B4F", 2, null, 7), Rect(150, 164, 120, 14, "#6FCF97", "#2F6B4F", 2, null, 7), Rect(165, 180, 96, 14, "#6FCF97", "#2F6B4F", 2, null, 7), SvgText("类囊体膜", 260, 148, 12, "#1F5C3A", "start", "semibold"), Line(40, 255, 130, 196, "#5B8DEF", 3), Polygon("124,190 140,192 134,204", "#5B8DEF"), SvgText("H₂O", 25, 268, 13, "#2F6B4F", "start", "semibold"), Line(210, 104, 210, 50, "#EB5757", 3), Polygon("205,44 210,34 215,44", "#EB5757"), SvgText("O₂", 224, 58, 13, "#B03A3A", "start", "semibold"), Line(315, 170, 370, 170, "#F2994A", 3), Polygon("364,164 374,170 364,176", "#F2994A"), SvgText("ATP + NADPH", 348, 202, 12, "#8A5A1A", "end", "semibold")], "0 0 420 300")
darkSvg = Svg([Circle(210, 150, 64, "#F4EEFF", "#8E6CC9", 3), SvgText("Calvin", 210, 140, 16, "#5E3E8C", "middle", "semibold"), SvgText("循环", 210, 164, 14, "#5E3E8C", "middle", "semibold"), Line(350, 70, 276, 126, "#5B8DEF", 3), Polygon("270,120 286,122 278,136", "#5B8DEF"), SvgText("CO₂", 364, 64, 13, "#2F6B4F", "start", "semibold"), Line(60, 90, 160, 118, "#F2994A", 3), Polygon("154,112 170,114 162,128", "#F2994A"), SvgText("ATP + NADPH", 34, 76, 12, "#8A5A1A", "start", "semibold"), Line(270, 200, 345, 258, "#F2994A", 3), Polygon("339,252 353,254 345,264", "#F2994A"), SvgText("C₆H₁₂O₆", 316, 286, 13, "#8A5A1A", "start", "semibold"), Line(160, 186, 60, 250, "#9AA0A6", 3), Polygon("54,246 70,246 64,258", "#9AA0A6"), SvgText("ADP + NADP⁺", 26, 270, 12, "#5F6368", "start", "semibold")], "0 0 420 300")
